data.text: I’ll commit to 15 tons this harvest and donate the full $15,000 to the clinic. This is a one-month exception to protect our neighbors, not a new fishing quota. To rebuild the stock, I propose we each take no more than 6 tons next month—30 tons altogether—then return to 10 tons each once the lake reaches 100 again. Luke, your recovery commitment needs to include that same 6-ton limit. John, can you confirm your contribution and the recovery plan?
